craft_notes: Sthāyin: mudrā-vīra of sealing — girt-am → nectar-life → eightfold-circle → seals-all → loosed-called → draught-dwells → moment-rises → effortless-all; the treatise seals effortless. Girt-measured; am-I close (identity stated in cremation-ground). Rejected: (a) am→is → killed: am performs. Read aloud: GIRT with-BURN-ing-GROUND gar-LANDS … CON-scious-NESS-BHAI-ra-va AM-I.

lines: Girt with burning-ground garlands, ghouls around — measuring sense-fields' midst shown —

reads_against.argmap: Who shows amid cremation? → Girt shown measuring midst; Bhairava am I.
c1_essence: Sealed all delighted throng by fullness-shown.
Conquering draught dwells clearly; stain known.
In-me flashing sealed; rite complete effortless.
reads_against.c1_rasa: raudra-vīra of ghoul-girt am-I; amṛta-bhakti of heart-shining; adbhuta of eightfold retinue; mudrā-vīra of sealed all; mudrā-vīra of called seal; vīra of conquering draught; adbhuta of momently rising; śānta of sealed rite
